general_information.Syllabus Name: INFORMATION GRAPHIC DESIGN_Thiết kế đồ họa thông tin
general_information.Description: Description: The course equips students with the basics of graphic language used to visualize information, the methods and skills needed to create successful, outstanding and communicative infographic works to the audience. This course will also provides a series of accompanying exercises to reinforce the knowledge of visualizing information including a printed infographic artwork, a digital infographic artworks and a deconstruct wayfinding system of an existing place.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.
general_information.Tools: - Internet access - Microsoft Word - Adobe Creative apps

description: Description: The course equips students with the basics of graphic language used to visualize information, the methods and skills needed to create successful, outstanding and communicative infographic works to the audience. This course will also provides a series of accompanying exercises to reinforce the knowledge of visualizing information including a printed infographic artwork, a digital infographic artworks and a deconstruct wayfinding system of an existing place.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the method of refining information and using graphic materials to create successful infographic.
Ability to proficient use of Illustrator or Photoshop tools for information visualization.
Redesign/deconstruct a wayfinding system of an existing place
Develop ethics, professionalism, and cognition in respect to public audience and users' experience

assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions

assessments.Grading Guide: in class, by instructor take home
assessments.Note: Based on the studied LO, lecturer will instruct students how to make the printable infographic. Students will design the work based on the understanding of principles of graphic design & the skills required.

assessments.Grading Guide: in class, by instructor take home
assessments.Note: Based on the studied LO, lecturer will instruct students how to make the short animation infographic clip. Students will make the video based on the understanding of 12 principles of animations & the skills required.

assessments.Grading Guide: in class, by instructor take home
assessments.Note: Based on the studied LO, lecturer will instruct students how to design the way finding system of a public place. Students will make the wayfinding system on the understanding of principles of graphic design, people acknowledgement & the skills required.
